messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: ap-southeast-1 gpu-pool 'ap-sg-1a' reporting high queue depth and 503 spike, 12% reqs failing over last 2m. Autorepair kicked, but pool health=DEGRADED
mira: seeing it on the heatmap, GPU memory pressure and tail latency spiking around 6:44 UTC
samir: @mira can you confirm if we’re seeing OOMs or driver restarts in the logs?
mira: driver restarts 3x in the last 10m, kernel OOM killed a few worker processes. grabbing logs now, will paste snippets
liam: We should start steering traffic off APAC before it cascades. propose GSLB weight shift apac -> eu-west in stages (30% -> 60% -> 100%)
nina: note: eu-west adds ~120ms p50 for APAC users and token cost ~2x. need bus/ops tradeoff decision (SLA vs P&L)
samir: can we fail over to the reserved dedicated pool in APAC? Reserved has 200 GPUs but current util ~80% due to batch jobs
mira: I can pause batch training in apac to free dedicated pool, will take ~90s to quiesce and another ~60s to warm model caches
deploy-bot: rolling weight update available in GSLB UI (staging -> prod)
liam: executing initial 30% shift now. Use this API to apply gradual weights:
```
curl -X POST "https://gslb.internal/api/v1/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GSLB_TOKEN" -d '{"changes":[{"region":"ap-southeast-1","weight":0.7},{"region":"eu-west-1","weight":0.3}],"type":"gradual","ttl":20}'
```
liam: TTL 20s so edge caches will pick up gradual steering, avoids sudden connection drain
nina: started shift — seeing queue depth drop in ap-sg-1a, eu-west backend CPU jumped ~18%
samir: pausing low-priority batch jobs in apac now to release reserved capacity
mira: batch pause issued (job-controller), estimated drain 120s
ops-bot: health-check update: ap-southeast-1 gpu-pool nodes healthy 88/100, failing 12 nodes flagged for auto-repair
liam: bumping eu-west concurrency caps by 15% and nudging autoscaler min replicas up to handle burst
nina: cost FYI for finance: rough estimate +$0.15/token if fully shifted for 1h; partial shift should be lower, logging actuals to cost dashboard
samir: important: when we steer back, avoid prefer-cache=true on the routing change to prevent stale KV caches producing regressions — prefer warm but validate outputs
mira: agreed. plan for reverse: wait for apac pool >95% healthy for 10m, then canary 20% back -> 60% -> 100% with prefer-cache=false for first pass
liam: monitoring traces for generation regressions during shift, no anomalies so far in sampled requests
ina: opening an incident board entry #INC-2026 and tagging finance and product for SLA/cost posture notes
ops-bot: note: ticket created for post-incident RCA (driver/kernel) assigned to eng-ml-infra
mira: apac pool health climbing, nodes recovering after driver restart patch, currently 96% healthy at 10:05 UTC. initiating reverse roll as planned
liam: applying reverse weights: 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 8 minutes, TTL 30s for smoother edges
ops-bot: Observability: KV cache hit rates stable during reverse, no user-visible regressions so far
liam: reverse complete, traffic on ap-southeast-1 back to baseline; eu-west concurrency and autoscaler restored to prior limits
mira: final check: apac pool stable 99%, no further restarts in last 15m
nina: logging cost delta into the incident and sending a short note to finance: incremental cost ~+$1200 for this event
samir: root cause ticket updated: suspected GPU driver/firmware bug, follow-ups scheduled with hardware vendor
liam: closing operational thread — will keep RCA notes in INC-2026 and schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident state: resolved. Escalation/RCAs created (ENG/ML-INFRA).
